ITEM 1 | Pale orange-pink fillet piece with flaky, layered texture, slightly moist, with light browning on edges, roughly 9 cm long by 4 cm wide and 1.5 cm thick, sitting at bottom center of plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Darker brown-glazed fillet piece with crisp, slightly charred surface and visible skin-like edge, roughly 6 cm long by 4 cm wide and 1.5 cm thick, next to the lighter fillet | 80
ITEM 3 | Bright green broccoli florets with dense tree-like clusters, slightly glossy and firm, spanning roughly 10 cm across on right side of plate, stems pale green | 120
ITEM 4 | Thinly sliced radishes with bright red skin and white flesh, crisp and moist, arranged in an overlapping fan about 8 cm across at top of plate | 45
ITEM 5 | Halved and whole cherry tomatoes, glossy red with some orange, juicy and soft-skinned, scattered in the center beside the broccoli, about 6 cm across total | 50
ITEM 6 | Small olive-green Brussels sprouts, roughly 2.5 cm diameter, some browned and slightly charred on surface, firm and whole, scattered along lower left and bottom | 60
ITEM 7 | Sliced cucumber rounds and half-moons, pale green with darker skin edges, moist and crisp, about 6 cm across on left side | 35
ITEM 8 | Thin pale green strips of a crisp vegetable with slightly translucent edges, scattered in a loose pile on left among cucumber, about 5 cm long | 15
ITEM 9 | Pale white onion rings, thin and translucent-edged, slightly glossy, curling near the lower right of the fillets, about 6 cm across | 20
ITEM 10 | Thin shaved pale yellow-white flakes, dry and matte, scattered on top of the lighter fillet and near the onion, small amounts | 5
